articles.description:
Trippy hack 'n' slash sequel (and, for the benefit of anyone planning for this year’s Advent Calendar guessing game in the RPS Discord, my current second-favouritest game of 2026) Control Resonant has a big old update out today. As declassified by Remedy, it not only adds the pledged New Game++ mode for plus-deficient game replayers, but makes absolutely bloody loads of smaller bug fixes and quality of life tweaks.
Read more
articles.title: Control Resonant's New Game++ update also squashes some of my least favourite bugs, including the one where magic doors change my trousers

articles.author: Jon Martindale
articles.description:
Note from James, 02/10: We've heard your complaints that some of the wording in this piece - a lot of which, if I'm honest, was added/changed by me in the edit - overstates the chair's potential health benefits. The HBADA’s X7 chair may reduce back pain during long periods of sitting at your desk but it will not literally fix your spine. While it is and will remain the RPS way to indulge in some occasional hyperbole, we don't want to suggest that swivel chairs cure physical conditions, so I've clarified these bits to avoid confusion.


AI is everywhere, exhausting to keep up with, and increasingly perceived as harmful to games. But that’s mostly generative AI; the more limited, less media-scraping and energy-hungry breeds of artificial intelligence can still play a harmless, maybe even useful role, especially on the hardware side. Even if it finds itself in some unexpected places, as is the case with HBADA’s X7 chair.
While AI-powered lumbar support sounds like the kind of gimmicky nonsense that’s become all too common in 2026, I’ve been using an X7 for a week, and it’s... surprisingly effective? Definitely for straightening up my posture, which I'm hopeful will help with my recurring back pain issues. It’s been a very pleasant surprise.
Read more
articles.title: I'm not sure the "AI" in my chair's lumbar support actually counts as AI, but it has been smart enough to help my posture

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Capcom have done a brisk trade in Resident Evil remakes this past decade. They've gone back to formula with Resident Evil 2, Resident Evil 3, and Resident Evil 4, not just bumping up the resolution and revarnishing the cutscenes, but writing new variations on the old survival horror fables. There's a Resident Evil: Code Veronica regurgitation due in 2027, and a Resident Evil 0 resurrection allegedly to follow in 2028.
The problems with this strategy are perhaps expressed by my previous sentence's struggle to come up with extra synonyms for "remake": sooner or later, Capcom are going to run out of original games they can credibly overhaul. Including the forthcoming or rumoured projects, they've only got Resident Evils 5 and 6 left now before they hit the "modern era" inaugurated by Resident Evil 7, the game that introduced the fancy RE Engine used by the remakes.
 Read more
articles.title: Capcom aren't just running out of Resident Evil games to remake - they're banking on it, with a mysterious "crossover" planned when the timelines collide

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Ever since The Witcher 3's decade-on expansion Songs of the Past was revealed not to be a windup nor a case of empthy rumourmongering, I've been eating up as many details about its story as CD Projekt Red have offered. The truth is that, outside of showing off the setting and a few of the characters Gerry'll chat to, they've kept their lips pretty tight. On one hand, I get wanting to keep narrative surprises intact, but on the other, it'd be nice to see the studio be less vague about this extra chapter of a story folks assumed they'd already seen through to a satisfying end a decade ago.
So, in addition to scouring other interviews about the DLC, I flung my own questions at CD Projekt Red story director Marcin Blacha, who worked in that role and as a lead writer on TW3 back in the day.
Read more
articles.title: The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past's setting "felt like a really natural way to go", CD Projekt Red story director says, while parrying my attempts to breach the DLC's guard

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
Port Desire, the hemmed-in city setting of immersive sim No Law, is hard to place. At points, it reminds me of walking around Lisbon. It shares that Portuguese city's verticality, where hill-straddling streets shouldered by colourful houses and corner shops can feel like tiers on a wedding cake. The strong sunlight and bursts of foliage reinforce the mediterranean vibes. Yet, the port city's structure and history is much closer to Kowloon Walled City, the ungoverned Chinese enclave that existed within British-owned Hong Kong.
Through the 1900s, with the British government taking a hands-off policy to the tiny district and the Chinese government exercising no control over its citizens, Kowloon became the most densely populated city on earth, with 33,000 citizens living in just 2.6-hectare borders. With virtually no official police presence, the city attracted anyone looking for a less-observed, less-regulated life – gangs, refugees, and a surprising number of unlicensed dentists.
As one of No Law's creative directors, Tor Frick, tells it, Port Desire is very similar. Not specifically the dentists bit, more the general, isolated lawlessness.
Read more
articles.title: "We want people to try and outsmart the game": No Law aims for Arkane-style reactivity within a dangerous walled city

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Despite recently having overseen the laying off of 268 staff in the second of multiple rounds of cuts planned for this financial year, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has denied that their are plans to sell Microsoft's gaming division. The bloodletting at Xbox in recent months has not only seen workers let go, but the place of studios within the company's structure being altered. Rather than lots of studios with their own degree of independence, Xbox have been parting ways with many studios and consolidating what remains under a small number of arms led by the bosses of the likes of Activision and Bethesda.
Read more
articles.title: "Xbox is not for sale" despite all of the layoffs and neat repackaging of studios within Microsoft's corporate structure, CEO Asha Sharma says

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Tom Clancy's The Division and Star Wars Outlaws studio Massive Entertainment just got, er, massiver. Parent company Ubisoft have announced that they're now "the global label" for several other series, including Ghost Recon and Splinter Cell alongside at least one original game, World War fantasy MOBA March of Giants.
 Read more
articles.title: The Division developers Massive are now "the global brand" in charge of Splinter Cell and Ghost Recon, alongside a new Ubisoft dieselpunk MOBA

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Fantasy RPG Queen's Domain is frequently likened by certain other websites to From Software's King's Field games and The Elder Scrolls 3: Morrowind, so I'm going to put my nose in the air and forcibly compare it to something else. Looks like, errrrrr, a first-person Ico with Mayan architectural influences, maybe a touch of Final Fantasy's Ivalice period here and there. It's set on an island with shorelines you could compare to Halo's Silent Cartographer level, if you rubbed your eyes with breakfast cereal. Have I thoroughly confused you? Don't worry, here is a trailer.
 Read more
articles.title: First-person RPG Queen's Domain pitches you against an island of gorgeous freaks with naught but a flying sword and infinite throwing daggers

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
No More Heroes and Killer7 developers Grasshopper Manufacture have split from erstwhile parent company NetEase, founder Goichi "Suda51" Suda has announced. NetEase bought them back in 2021, as part of the acquisition of Gungho Online Entertainment. Now, they're going indie. According to Suda, the change reflects "a strong desire to deliver titles in an even wider variety of styles to video game lovers everywhere".
 Read more
articles.title: "NO GAME NO LIFE": Grasshopper Manufacture have leapt from the jaws of NetEase and gone indie again

articles.author: Ashley Schofield
articles.description:
Deadpool’s a weird character. Like fellow mutant Wolverine, Wade Wilson is a trained killer whose primary superpower is a healing factor that lets him recover and reform from any wound, even if bisected or decapitated. Unlike Wolverine, Wade knows he’s in a fictional medium, be it a comic book, movie, or game, and physically can’t stop quipping about that fact and referencing things in and out of his world. It’s up to the writer whether this is sheer coincidence (as in, he’s genuinely just psychotic and his insane ramblings happen to be the truth), or a true meta awareness granting him power over narrative itself.
This is a trait that Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls handles smartly, which in a way is surprising, because it usually makes him quite annoying. In most appearances, Deadpool references everything — nothing is safe. Marvel editorial, art of all mediums new and old, assorted real-life  celebrity drama, specific stories from comics’ past (not just Marvel, either), and more I can’t think of right now; all of it ripe fruit for Wade to riff on in one of the many jokes-per-minute spouting from his scarred mouth. This became true of the vast majority of his comic runs, once the meta awareness, fourth-wall-breaking became a central part of his character identity, and defined non-comic appearances like High Moon’s 2013 Deadpool game and Ryan Reynolds' (admittedly, kinda perfect) portrayal from the 2016 film onwards. No, X-Men Origins: Wolverine does not count.
Read more
articles.title: The importance of being earnest: How Marvel Tōkon's Deadpool trades ridicule for fighting game reverence

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
A little bit of extra waiting is in order for Crimson Desert's first proper expansion, Charting the Unknown. Originally set to arrive midway through October, it's now been moved back by a couple of weeks to allow for some extra fine-tuning of the thousand or so funky open world activities devs Pearl Abyss have jammed into it.
Read more
articles.title: Crimson Desert's first expansion, Charting the Unknown, delayed so Pearl Abyss get more time to polish and stabilise the red pudding

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
It has perhaps never been easier to join a witch or wizard school without being a Guy Who Rhymes With Bally Trotter. Academies of the occult abound in videogames. True, there has yet to be an amazing Little Witch Academia adaptation, and I'm still waiting for that Arbitrary Metric take on Naomi Novik's A Deadly Education, to say nothing of Failbetter's take on Terry Pratchett's Equal Rites, but in the short term, I've been enjoying the demo for Songs of Glimmerwick, which goes on sale today.
 Read more
articles.title: Come play the flute and reshape the very earth in Songs of Glimmerwick, a magic school RPG from the creators of Eastshade

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
My very soul has been cleft into pieces on this day. January 3rd, 902 AD. First, my Christian faith fractured in twain. I stand in Rome, head of the Roman Rite and now the leader of the Catholic world. My neighbours to the east have chosen to walk a different path, transforming their Greek Rite into a new Orthodoxy followed by the Byzantine Empire.
It’s a brave new world in Crusader Kings 3’s By God Alone expansion, made even tougher to face by the three additional wounds I gained right at the moment of the split. All three of my wives have divorced me, serving their papers within seconds of each other. Taken alongside the betrothal that my fourth wife-to-be broke not too long before the schism, it really stings. Sure, I’m the Pope and thus should be celibately devoting myself to God, but a breakup’s a breakup. It’s not all consecrated bread and wine when you’ve managed to end up on Wikipedia’s list of sexually active popes thanks to an utterly hilarious bug.
Read more
articles.title: Crusader Kings 3's By God Alone expansion offers plenty of holy hijinks, even if your polyamorous Pope doesn't get divorced three times in one day

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Arc Raiders developers Embark heavily underestimated the challenges of creating a full-blown live service game, executive producer Aleksander Grøndal has conceded in a new interview. The extraction shooter launched with an ambition for monthly post-release updates that ultimately proved untenable, resulting in an exhausted and unhappy team who were "constantly overshooting our capacity".
 Read more
articles.title: "Ultimately, we asked 'why are we doing this?'": the creators of Arc Raiders wildly underestimated how hard it is to make a live service game

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
In case you missed it, September happened. Technically it’s still happening, and we have one more exclusive post for RPS Premium Supporters coming this week, but this time I fancy doing the monthly rewards roundup within the month being rounded up. Lest armoured date pedants infiltrate my flat with breaching charges, and start hitting my shins with their pernickety sticks.
Thanks again to all our Supporters, preem or otherwise, and turbo double-thanks to anyone who filled in our Supporters survey. This has granted us some immensely helpful guidance on how to steer Supp rewards in the future, as well as some important feedback on the site more generally. You’re all, and I don’t say this about a lot of people, da best.
Read more
articles.title: All the RPS Supporter rewards for September 2026: Model ships, maze cities, and the tyranny of content

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
When I first learned about Core Values, the upcoming expansion to factory automation game Satisfactory, I didn't grasp the scale of the challenge developer Coffee Stain had set themselves. 'So, the game is set underground now?' I thought. 'I'll just stick up some more lights and make the same factory I always have.' Yet, as I covered yesterday, that won't be possible. For a start because you'll need to use new logistics tools to connect your factory buildings – conveyor belts aren't gone, but they're nowhere near as useful as they once were.
Another major difference, though, is a design problem for the developers: how to make a perfectly-sized cave.
Read more
articles.title: "I always see it kind of like a triangle": The surprising challenge of making the perfectly-sized cave in Satisfactory expansion Core Values

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Midway through September, modder SquallyDaBeanz released a solo-developed custom campaign for Baldur's Gate 3 in beta, adding an extra chapter to the RPG's main story. Neatly nestled between the RPG's second and third acts, the mod sends you and your party on a trip through The Chionthar Wilds while the Absolute's Army marches on towards the city the series is named after. SquallyDaBeanz has now offered a bit more explanation as to why they reckon the second section of BG3's established story benefits from having a few more forks in the road before the serious business of the final act begins.
Read more
articles.title: "Getting sidetracked doesn’t feel too unnatural": Baldur's Gate 3 Act Two Expansion modder on how they seamlessly fit a "detour" to fight an army into the RPG's plot

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 features a re-engineered, "more localized and persistent" weather system that ranges in intensity from physically credible rainbows to full-bore hurricanes, according to Rockstar vice president of art for lighting and rendering Owen Shepherd. As ever with GTA, the question is to what extent this will materially affect your doings in the new open world game, but at the very least, it seems like there's scope to pack in the core Bonnie & Clyde routine and become an amateur weather watcher for hours at a time.
 Read more
articles.title: GTA 6 will simulate hurricanes, rainbows and persistent, dynamic clouds, among other efforts to make you stop doing crime and become a weather nerd

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
It feels weird that Deadlock is technically a game that isn't out yet, doesn't it? You can't even just play it as someone that's never done so, you have to have someone that's already got access to send you an invite. Valve didn't even really acknowledge its existence publicly, and they still sort of treat it as this little secret that everyone's in on. Two years on, though, it's still getting updates, and the latest one arrived today changing… well, a lot.
 
Read more
articles.title: With Deadlock's latest updating promising six new heroes, over 10,000 new voice lines and too much more to mention, it's clear Valve are still pretty committed to it

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
I have a working theory that above all other aspects, the Vibe (with a capital V) of a game is the most important thing to enrapture a hypothetical audience. A strong Vibe is not a guarantee of such a thing, this algorithmic world we live in denies us such luxuries, it's just the most important starting point. The Vibe does not look like any one thing, the only rule is that it must elicit a response along the lines of, "now what's this, then?" Big Stretch, a game jam physics-based platformer that features hardly a semblance of assets, feels like it proves that theory to me.
 
Read more
articles.title: Sometimes the thing you need is a wonderfully ethereal physics platformer jam game where you are a little round guy with very stretchy arms called Big Stretch

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Go ahead and boot up Steam for me. Underneath the ad banner for whoever paid to be there for that day and the featured and recommended sections, you'll find a section titled discounts and events. As it currently stands, this section is hand curated by Valve to highlight some site-wide relevant sales. But Valve have been changing Steam up a lot in recent years, namely a widening of every aspect of it, and now this discount and events section will move away from being curated to being "more dynamic and personalized for each customer."
 
Read more
articles.title: Valve is changing Steam's homepage discounts and events section to go the way of the algorithm to get you to look at, and buy, obviously, more games

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
When you start factory automation game Satisfactory you awake in a drop pod plunging towards the surface of an alien world. In its first expansion you'll be heading a little deeper. Set entirely in an underground biome, Core Values sees you trying to build a thriving mining operation in a world that is limited in space and light, where even navigating its tunnels can become a challenge.
Though, the team are keen to emphasise that Core Values isn't just Satisfactory with the lights turned off. It will be bringing a whole new set of logistics tools (and new challenges with them), so getting resources from mining point A to refining point B won't always be as straightforward as just sending them down a conveyor belt.
Read more
articles.title: "You will not be using belts": Satisfactory's first expansion isn't the same game set underground - there's a whole new set of resource-moving toys to master

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
"At the time, I didn't immediately think my boss was filling the walls of our place of business with corpses," so opens the reveal trailer for Something is Wrong with the Library, the latest game from the studio that is most hard to pin down genre-wise, Strange Scaffold. Though, considering they've made games about isekaing people, trading space babies on the stock market, and cuck-, I mean, Clickolding, perhaps the way you pin them down is "games for freaks and weirdos."
 
Read more
articles.title: After trading space babies and running people over with a truck, Strange Scaffold want you to organise a haunted library in Something is Wrong with the Library

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Has the pre-GTA 6 autumn exhaustion hit you yet? There's already been a lot of games this month, but this train stops for no one, especially with Rockstar's behemoth looming over it all. Today is no different, as after a long wait and several delays, Nivalis Nights is finally out, bringing you back to the cyberpunk world of Cloudpunk once again, only with a restaurant managing slant to it all.
 
Read more
articles.title: Set up your own ramen bar and explore a voxel cyberpunk city in the slice-of-lifey Nivalis Nights, out now

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
While the cover's flown off The Witcher 3 Remastered today, September 29th, the wait for the RPGs elusive extra expansion goes on until next year. I've had rather mixed feelings on the decision to extend Gerry from the River's tale beyond the execellent ending offered by the Blood and Wine DLC thus far, something that CD Projekt Red's general tight-lippedness when it comes to dicussing story details hasn't helped. They have at least now dropped some crumbs as to how the new expansion will stack up tonally compared to its peers and what it provides space for that the existing game didn't.
Read more
articles.title: The Witcher 3 Songs of the Past sounds like it's mirroring Blood and Wine in being "a lot dreamier" than a "bread-and-butter Witcher story"

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Darktide continues to cling tightly, perhaps even aggressively, to my Steam installations, my occasionally waning interest repeatedly re-sparked by the addition of akimbo-autopistolling chem fiends or haughty toasterpeople. A live service sucker, it makes me. Today's Depths of the Damned update, the grimdark co-op shooter's biggest since the Skitarii rocked up, continues the trend: it's centered around a massive new mission that's as revolting as it is compelling.
Read more
articles.title: I perished in the flesh pipes of Darktide's Depths of the Damned update, and you will too

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
The recent screening of Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has proven a thing of existential horror for many grey-haired Zeldenthusiasts. Is that you, Link? What have they done to you, boy? Why do you look like a possessed doll? Where have all your sharp edges gone? Eek, I can see individual divots on Epona's neck.
Rest easy, traveller. Let us play the titular Ocarina and warp back to the good old days. No, not the heyday of the N64 – that three-pronged controller was an instrument of the Devil. I mean the real good old days, when Link looked like a cockroach and hills hadn't been invented yet. But oh, what's this? We have played the Ocarina wrong and messed up the spacetime continuum. We have somehow generated a version of NES-era Zelda that overlaps with another long-lost game, Namco's 60-floor maze RPG The Tower of Druaga - itself a huge influence on the original Zelda games. It appears that Prince Ganondorf has been abducted by the evil queen Zeldaga. That harridan! Time to go questing for some keys.
 Read more
articles.title: The Tower of Zeldaga is a free retro mash-up of Zelda and Druaga in which you rescue Ganondorf from some evil blonde queen

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
LEGO Skylines is the new plastic city-builder from Cities: Skylines 2 and Surviving the Aftermath developers Iceflake Studios, published by Paradox Interactive. I've played an hour or so of a preview build, just long enough to devise a circular highway of coffee shops, glass-fronted houses, unaccountably cheerful farms, and playgrounds poking up haphazardly like fungus. Kind of like the M25, but more rustickal. There's a park in the middle that can't work out which century it's in, with an ornamental fountain every ten paces to baffle the casual stroller.
 
Read more
articles.title: "A quite beautiful compromise": The LEGO Skylines devs did consider brick by brick building, but decided it was too much fuss for players

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Today, September 29th, The Witcher 3 is back on the path in Remastered form. With that remaster bringing a host of tweaks to the decade-old RPG, there was always going to be an adjustment period for the RPG's established mods. One that won't work right out of the gate is the WAR Project - an ongoing effort to restore a plague-themed questline CD Projekt Red abandoned prior to release.
However, the modders behind it have made clear this is just a temporary bump in the trail and promised "something extra" for the update that brings their demo up to remastered spec.
Read more
articles.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered has scuppered an ambitious cut plague quest restoration mod, but there'll be "something extra" in the update that gets it working again

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
CD Projekt have released the full list of PC system requirements for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered, a free upgrade for the base edition of the grizzled and cantankerous fantasy action-RPG. This covers both the previously announced minimum PC specs and the recommended, ultra, ray-tracing minimum, ray-tracing recommended, and path tracing configurations.
 Read more
articles.title: CD Projekt release full updated Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered system specs, including ray-tracing and path-tracing requirements

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
There's been a wave of furry horror games with surprisingly elaborate tactical simulation elements, and when I say "wave", I mean that I'm aware of two. One is Casualties: Unknown, a 2D misericore spelunking experience with an injury system so byzantine it took Oisin multiple paragraphs to work out how to die. The other, somewhat nicer game is Fright Train, a swish B-movie survival shooter in which you are a literal dog soldier, the magnificent Doug Barker.
 
Read more
articles.title: Fright Train is the best Call of Duty Zombies alternative I've played in ages, despite starring a dog

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
Early in horror game Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival, the character you play, Aidan, and his partner Sunny, are pushing the bounds of the sex they enjoy together. Already into BDSM, they discover a puzzle box that, when solved, will allow them to explore a new extreme of their fetish play. However, when they unlock the box it summons a set of torture demons called Cenobites and Sunny is torn to fleshy pieces and sent to hell. From that violent beginning, Aidan bargains with one of the demons of torture to find a way to bring Sunny back to life and be made whole.
Not your average walk in the park  – or, if it is, I am deeply sorry for you. (My park is great. There is a duck pond). Nonetheless, it is a good starting point for a horror game based on Clive Barker's horror series.
Still, when I spoke to Hellraiser: Revival's developers I wanted to know if Sunny was being punished for enjoying her fetish.
Read more
articles.title: "We didn't want to demonise fetish or BDSM": People aren't dying in horror game Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival because of what they do in the bedroom

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Happy this week all! ...Ugh, you are all still here. When I went on holiday last week, I was hoping that I'd return to find that the whole "videogame journalism career" thing was just a fleeting delusion brought on by excess consumption of unripe pears. Perhaps I've actually been a wealthy gentleman gadabout this whole time, free of any need to keep the hellmouth topped up with layoff reports in order to stave off deprivation and disaster.
The one consolation - other than EIC Julian's many encouraging facial expressions and hand gestures – is that people are still making new PC games, and a few of them are actually quite interesting! Here's the latest list of new releases.
 Read more
articles.title: This week in PC games: new Ace Combat, Transport Fever 3, and a System Shock-alike set on a disco space station

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Hearts of Iron 4 developers Paradox Interactive have prohibited the use of Discord profile pictures of historical figures born after 1st January 1800, save for official in-game portraits, amid an uproar caused by a moderator banning somebody for using a photograph of Republic of Turkey founder Mustafa Kemal Atatürk.
Discord server members are still free to "use any official Hearts of Iron IV in-game portraits, including those from after 1800, with the exception of prominent leaders of Nazi Germany," according to a Discord post attributed to game director Laszlo "Batya" Pieper (copied to Reddit). In the same post, Pieper notes that "Paradox never aims to review history or take positions on political figures, and we clearly handled that responsibility poorly."
 Read more
articles.title: "We clearly handled that responsibility poorly": Paradox ban Discord profile pics of historical figures born after 1800, after bust-up with Hearts of Iron 4 players over Atatürk banning

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
Sundays are for recovering from the friend-of-a-spouse’s wedding you attended on Saturday while suffering from an acute case of Old Person’s Back. Unfortunately, the time for recovery has in fact passed, as you have already moved to the more immediately satisfying phase of assigning blame. Possible suspects: your swivel chair, your mattress, the PC monitor you had to laboriously re-box for transit, your sofa, and that most connviving, spine-bending bastard of all, light walking. Spoiled for choice, you sit down in your untrustworthy chair and begin to read some of the week’s writing highlights instead.
Read more
articles.title: The Sunday Papers

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
If your game immediately makes me think of any of Fumito Ueda's in any sort of way, the likelihood is that I am to play it. There are only so many Ueda games (three, by my count) and there will only be so many (hopefully more that upcoming fourth one isn't the last), so when something rocks up that fits into that vibe like TALON TOWERS, a parkour platformer set on dilapidated structures that stand high above an infinitely stretching fog, I'm going to be pulled in.
 
Read more
articles.title: TALON TOWERS is a Fumito Ueda-coded parkour platformer about hopping around massive structures while avoiding falling to your foggy doom

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Just hearing that a game has mashed two genres together does not generally excite me. It's a useful shorthand, maybe, but there's only so many roguelike deckbuilders I can take. Once in a while, however, a mashup comes along that makes me think, "well that doesn't seem right," and my ears perk up like a dog that's learned how to spell walk. Today, that mashup comes in the form of Brokensides, a psychological horror beat 'em up where you play as a violent sea bunny recently freed from imprisonment after committing a Cardinal Crime.
 
Read more
articles.title: Suplex and shatter glass enemies after being in prison for committing a cardinal crime in the psychological horror beat 'em up Brokensides

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Tense platforming? Riveting, punchy action combat? Complex, thought provoking puzzles? Is this what we come to video games for? Of course not! It's for the menus, those sweet, sweet collections of pixels that let us tailor our experience and commit crimes like turning off the music so you can listen to a podcast you'll only half pay attention to. Well, that's at least what Video Game Menu: The Game will have you believe, a video game about video game menus (perhaps I didn't need to explain it to you, it's kind of in there in the name).
 
Read more
articles.title: Video Game Menu: The Game is all about everyone's favourite gaming pastime: pressing random buttons in the menus and seeing what they change

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
My first thought when I played through the Chimera tank boss fight in Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty was probably something along the lines of, "wow, this sure looks expensive!" It's incredibly flashy to start off with, this Ghost in the Shell-esque tank chasing after you in a big set piece moment that ultimately culminates in it unwillingly hunkering down in one spot for your killing convenience. And as it turns out, such a big, boisterous boss fight takes a lot of work; two whole years, in fact.
 
Read more
articles.title: Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty's Chimera tank boss fight was apparently so complex it took two years of "reiterating over and over" to get it right

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
A developer's work is never done! On the very same day it launched, Control Resonant received a hotfix that tackled various complaints that were levied against the game's combat, making it slightly more manageable for those having a tougher time. While a fuller update won't be coming until next month, developer Remedy have outlined their plans for the next couple of updates, namely a New Game++ mode, and a photo mode.
 
Read more
articles.title: "Do 665 runs if you want!": Control Resonant is getting a new game++ mode next month, and don't worry you happy snappers, a photo mode is on the way too

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
I'm sure I had at least three more sets of Saturdays and Sundays in my September box. That thief time has snuck in again and picked up all the unattended days. If you see him, give him a whack on the back and see if he'll cough them back up again, I'm not quite ready to crack the wax seal on October 2026.
Read more
articles.title: What are we all playing this weekend?

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
There’s plenty to dislike about this latest round of corporate-mandated Xbox misery. The hundreds more human beings losing their livelihoods. The embracing of risk-averse factory line development. The fact that nobody, still, knows what on earth is happening with Arkane.
 Read more
articles.title: Microsoft's failure to find a home for Ninja Theory voids the one, very tenuous upside to Senua's SGF reveal

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
After months of smaller patches, Hytale’s early access phase is getting its inaugural Chapter update, confirmed release date and all. Chapter 1 is out on October 12th, and it’s a bundle of (mostly goblin-related) firsts: chiefly the game’s first "handcrafted" dungeon, a gruesome underground lair, and Hytale’s first bonefide boss fight, against a flamethrowing gob-king.
Read more
articles.title: Hytale's Chapter 1 update is all about them goblins, adding its first proper boss and "handcrafted" dungeon in October

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
Demo sessions are often terrible ways to see a game, doubly so at conferences. You want to sink into a game at your own pace (and with unbroken access to fresh cups of tea), not get dropped into the middle of the action, hoisted up again 20 minutes later and plonked into another section of a game. However, that's the nature of these things sometimes and it suits some games more than others.
Total War: Warhammer absolutely does not suit it.
Grand strategy games are built for armchair generals. Not just any armchair, either, a wingback one where the leather on the arms is nearly worn through where said general has rested their elbows in deep contemplation. They're not games made to be played in short bursts. As such, I can't really speak to Total War: Warhammer 40,000's end quality from its Gamescom demo, but perhaps it says something that after an hour where I played 20 minutes of the battle tutorial, 20 minutes of the campaign tutorial, and 20 minutes in a scenario where my Space Marine army faced an overwhelming assault from an ork horde, I still came away keen as the baked beans found in an Astra Militarium ration pack to play the full game.
Read more
articles.title: I got whomped by an Ork horde in Total War: Warhammer 40,000, definitely on purpose, to teach you a lesson about positioning

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
Armed Fantasia, a JRPG pitched as a spiritual successor the PS2-era roleplaying series Wild Arms – and led by former Wild Arms producer Akifumi Kaneko – has been cancelled. Digital Bros, the parent company of Armed Fantasia publishers 505 Games, announced in a financial statement that it was one of several games for which "The Group decided to discontinue development," the others being a sequel to F2P strategy game Battle Islands and action RPG Directorate Novitiate, which had already revealed its own demise in May.
Read more
articles.title: Colourful JRPG Armed Fantasia has been cancelled, four years after a successful Kickstarter campaign descended into delays and lawsuits

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
Arc Raiders developer Embark Studios is bowing to the pacifists and trialing a PvE mode in their extraction shooter. If you play between October 13th and 20th, you'll be able to flick a toggle that means you load either into the traditional world of Arc Raiders, where human players vie for the valuable scraps left behind in a ruined world watched over by killer robots, or a slightly safer version where the machines are still deadly but the humans can't hurt you.
"We’re seeing a large and growing group of Raiders who come to the Rust Belt for the co-op and the ARC, not fighting with other Raiders," Embark say in the post announcing the trial. "That group has become a core part of our community, so it’s important we learn how to support them properly rather than leave them working around the game."
Read more
articles.title: Arc Raiders is testing a PvE mode because "a large and growing group" refuse to hunt each other

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
I would hope that for most of you it would not be a controversial thing to hear me say I hate generative AI. It stinks! It is rotting everyone's brains, and the people shilling it don't even care (see Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang saying he doesn't think it matters that kids aren't actually learning things like basic math when they use AI). But - please don't leave yet - it sure does make for some primo storytelling. Like, for example, in the upcoming LOVE alt delete, a psychological horror visual novel where you are beta testing a chatbot that you're trying to date.
 
Read more
articles.title: LOVE alt delete is a Y2K horror visual novel where you use one AI chatbot to help you date another that, don't worry, doesn't use the nasty generative stuff

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
If it ain't broke, why fix it? That seems to be the thought process behind Iron Bramble, the next game from the devs behind Rusted Moss. Like its predecessor, Iron Bramble is a pixel art metroidvania, one where you have a grappling hook that lets you swing about the place at rapid pace, only this time the setting is a "cyber-gothic megastructure" and you play a story-eating demon (?) woman in a world where humanity's flesh bodies have all died out and their souls now reside in metal, robotic husks.
 
Read more
articles.title: I definitely suck at Iron Bramble's metroidvania grappling hook platforming, but its cyber-gothic megastructure world has me hungry for more

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Marathon will be "growing beyond extraction." That's what Bungie say in a new blog post outlining the future of the shooter, after announcing earlier this week that they'll be bringing back vaulted Destiny 2 campaigns. "Marathon launched as a cutthroat, winner-takes-all PvEvP experience," they explain. "We want to preserve that thrill for the players who enjoy it, while creating more ways for others to experience the world and find the level of challenge that works for them."
 
Read more
articles.title: The future of Marathon includes a fungus-filled Perimeter, a social hub, and a shift "beyond extraction"

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Right, I need you lot to pipe down for a minute because you're making games less interesting. Last week, The Blood of Dawnwalker director Konrad Tomaszkiewicz shared that the game's timer mechanics may be dropped in future installments of the vampire (eventual) series. This sounds like a boring decision to make if you ask me, as it's the thing that most interests me about the RPG. And now, according to Tomaszkiewicz in a new interview, the timer mechanic was actually toned down based on its early reception.
 
Read more
articles.title: Once upon a time The Blood of Dawnwalker's timer mechanic was a lot tougher, and it's because of all those pre-release complaints that it was made easier

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Control: Resonant is out today, and wouldn't you know it, there's already a hotfix. Though, day one updates aren't exactly new in this day and age now, are they? This particular patch looks like it's laser targeted at comments made in reviews about the game and how dang tough some of its enemies are, to which James would like you to know he says, "Pfft, wimps." Save your snark for him, not me!
 
Read more
articles.title: Control: Resonant is only just out of the door, and Remedy have already put out a hotfix with some stun-buffing combat tweaks and more

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader's story-concluding final DLC has been pushed back to December, developers Owlcat have announced. At the same time, they've introduced the companion around which this last expansion, Processional of the Damned, will revolve. Her name's Stella. She's  an "unsanctioned psyker", a "miracle sent by the Emperor himself", and is prone to shedding tears of blood.
Read more
articles.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader's final DLC is now coming in December, with an "unsanctioned psyker" companion who cries tears of blood

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Discord have rolled out a revised global age verification system, having delayed deploying one earlier this year following largely privacy-based backlash.
Read more
articles.title: Discord roll out revised age verification following delay due to pushback, pledging to be "safer for teens, same Discord for Adults"

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
I’m not saying that the reveal of Beat Saber’s "biggest update ever" was timed to coincide with a swell of VR interest induced by the new Steam Frame. But I am going to infer it, without evidence, before immediately moving on to what the sweaty sword-slashing rhythm game can expect when said update lands in Spring of 2027.
First and foremost is an entire new mode, Flux. This sees Beat Saber ditch the sabers and dial up the beating, demanding your own bare hands punch, prod, and slap their way through notes. A Beat Saber Unarmed build, basically. Looks fun! If probably no less tiring.
Read more
articles.title: Steam Frame-ready VR rhythm game Beat Saber is adding hand-tracking and a punchy new mode in its "biggest update ever"

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Obsidian will remain a "distinct" Obsidian with their own "creative identity and strengths", despite no longer operating independently of fellow Xbox-owned RPG makers Bethesda. That's according to Jill Braff, president of Bethesda and Microsoft's casual games division, in a memo sent to staff at the former following this week's layoffs and reorganising of studios at Xbox.
Read more
articles.title: Bethesda say new underlings Obsidian will retain their "distinct" creative identity, despite no longer being as free to work on their own creatively distinct series

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
Rockstar’s modding guidelines, recently updated in advance of GTA 6, say much about how you can’t dream up unofficial story missions, or give the upcoming instalment a cheeky unofficial PC port. But they don’t say a goddamn thing about crowbarring DLSS, DLAA, and FSR into 2008’s Grand Theft Auto IV, which is exactly what ChunkLeChuck’s DLSS IV mod has gone and done.
Read more
articles.title: After eighteen years of jaggedy bowling, a new mod bestows GTA 4 with DLSS and FSR support

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
After nearly a decade as a free-to-play game, Quake Champions is dropping all that nonsense in favour of being a nice and simple premium release on Steam. That means no more battle passes, no more loot boxes, no more premium currencies. They've even got rid of the store.
If you've played the game through any free events on Steam in the past, then you will be upgraded to a full version of the game automatically. And if you've bought any premium currencies in the past two months will be refunded.
However, while this is a welcome change, it should be seen in the context of Xbox's mission to fire 3200 developers.
Read more
articles.title: Following id layoffs, Quake Champions drops free-to-play nonsense and becomes a £9 game on Steam

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
Control Resonant is almost everything I wanted from a Remedy-flavoured character action game, including several sub-things I didn’t initially believe it would pull off. However, one particular ambition has failed to come good: the ability for me to play it in bed. Despite previously expressed plans for Steam Deck support, alas, Resonant needs to render just a bit too much paranturally skew-wiff Manhattan for it to comfortably run on Valve's handheld.
The bigger, beefier Steam Machine is a different story, which is good, because otherwise this would be a very short article. But with Control Resonant lacking any public SteamOS hardware compatibility ratings just a day before release, consider this a warning: it’s a damn fine game, on almost any modern PC that isn’t a Deck.
Read more
articles.title: The Steam Machine handles Control Resonant capably, but the promised Steam Deck support is a letdown

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
People Playground, a Steam sandbox game about torturing or otherwise messing with innocent ragdolls that work like crash test dummies, has had its Steam Workshop disabled over a "malicious mod" peddling malware. That's according to the game's developer Mestiez, who's urging anyone who played the game with mods on September 21st to run virus scans and has told everyone not to fire People Playground up until they've announced it's safe to do so.
Read more
articles.title: "This one is especially bad": Steam game about mistreating ragdolls suffers second bout of mod-based malware this year

articles.author: Julian Benson
articles.description:
A new patent from Microsoft shows how they want to record your facial expressions, show them to an AI, and have it redesign the game you're playing. It's not only your face they want, but also any words you might be muttering, growls you might be making, or, dare I say, even purrs.
The broader technology described in the patent is a process for game designers to prompt an AI to build out the narrative elements of a game, including objectives, sidequests, NPCs, dialogue, and items. Rather than stop at that first pass, the process would continue when players are in the game, analysing how they're playing to then generate new content based on their actions and reactions.
A quick peek behind the curtain: I, too, am using this technology and the rest of this article has been rewritten to match exactly the facial expression you are making right… now.
Read more
articles.title: Microsoft want to record your face and feed it to a generative AI, telling it to go off and design a game from your frown

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
The latest FromSoft game multiplayer mod is here, with Dark Souls 2 seamless co-op finally out in the wild. Modder Yui, maker of similar and very popular mods for Elden Ring, Nightreign, and the original Dark Souls, has poured a year and a bit of work into their latest creation.
Read more
articles.title: Dark Souls 2 seamless co-op mod is out now in alpha form, paving the way for more boss battering with mates

articles.author: Mark Warren
articles.description:
Less than 24 hours after confirming they've managed to secure a future outside of Xbox by going independent, State of Decay 3 studio Undead Labs have announced that they've had to lay off "a significant number" of staff as part of that transition. The news follows a second round of mass layoffs this year at the studios still under Microsoft's thumb. Undead Labs were one of the five studios Microsoft announced plans to split with during an initial round of layoffs in July.
Read more
articles.title: State of Decay 3 studio Undead Labs lay off "a significant number" of "exceptionally talented developers" after gaining independence from Xbox

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
Further details have emerged of the impact that Microsoft’s Xbox consolidation and job cuts programme is having on affected workers. World’s Edge, the studio that effectively manages strategy megaseries Age of Empires, has allegedly been hit hard, with an unnamed but verified creative director posting on industry forum ResetEra that "just under half" of all staff had been let go in the process of moving from Xbox’s direct control to Activision’s.
Read more
articles.title: Age of Empires studio World's Edge reportedly lose nearly half their staff and a new game project in mass Xbox layoffs

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
I was not a child that was built for skateboarding. Child me was a tad too wimpy to ever do anything so wicked cool as that. What if I scuffed my knee a little bit, or worse, embarrassed myself? So I did what any skateboarding curious child would do and bought a Tech Deck. And then I never learned how to get good at it. I am only slightly bitter about this adolescent failure of mine, yet all is not lost, for there is an entire video game out today that can let me experience such a feat digitally: Stuntboost.
 
Read more
articles.title: Stuntboost is a Tech Dech, skateboarding platformer all about doing sick flips on cardboard constructs in your bedroom, and it's out now

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Despite not being one myself, I do seem to write about furry-adjacent games for this ole webbed site, don't I? And I've got another one for you today! It's called Break The Night, a hack 'n' slash with slick movement, roguelike elements, and magical girls inspired by aesthetics from the late 2000s, and while it's still quite early days yet, I've been quite charmed by it.
 
Read more
articles.title: Furries, magical girls and slick hack 'n' slash combat blend promisingly together in the late 2000s inspired Break The Night

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Svatopluk Vít)
articles.description: Na GitHubu jste možná zahlédli malé barevné štítky s informacemi o projektu. Shields.io je nástroj, který je vytváří automaticky – ukazuje verzi, stav, licenci i další údaje. Pomáhá vývojářům i uživatelům.
articles.title: Shields.io: barevné štítky, které mluví za vás

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Sonda do světa otevřeného softwaru. Dnes si představíme minimalistický webový prohlížeč, vyzkoušíme moderní hudební přehrávač, podíváme se na nový dok pro Linux a naučíme se na zkoušku k obsluze amatérských rádiových zařízení.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (7. 10. 2026): naučte se na radioamatérské zkoušky

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Na LinuxDays se hodně mluvilo o tom, jak umělá inteligence mění open source, každodenní práci i bezpečnost. Řeč byla o chatbotech, telefonu Jolla Phone, RFID i aktuálních bezpečnostních hrozbách.
articles.title: AI proměňuje software, bezpečnost i svět kolem nás, zápisky z LinuxDays

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Budeme se zabývat vykreslováním povrchů těles složených z trojúhelníků. A nezapomeneme ani na popis funkce paměti hloubky (depth buffer, Z-buffer). Tím získáme základní poznatky nutné pro vykreslování 3D scén.
articles.title: WebGL: tvorba 3D grafiky s využitím programovatelné vykreslovací pipeline (3. část)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Monika Kutějová)
articles.description: Podíváme se na forenzní software české policie se skrytými ruskými vazbami, kritickou chybu ve FortiMailu, AI agenty útočící na vládní weby USA a Kanady, rozbití gangu KillSec a únik dat tří milionů lidí z Pentagonu.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: forenzní software české policie má skryté ruské vazby

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Projekt postmarketOS dostal nové jméno Nura. GhostBSD připravuje nové desktopové prostředí Mocka, které má v budoucnu postupně nahradit MATE. OpenMandriva vydala nový snapshot své rolling-release distribuce ROME s označením 26.09.
articles.title: postmarketOS se nově jmenuje Nura, GhostBSD připravuje nové prostředí

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Vydávám Mini Commander verze 2.0, novou verzi malého dvoupanelového správce souborů pro Linux. Je napsaný v C, používá ncurses a obsahuje vlastní prohlížeč i editor souborů.
articles.title: Mini Commander 2.0 přichází s podporou UTF-8

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: V neděli 4. října probíhá v Praze druhý den letošní konference LinuxDays. Podívejte se, jak vypadá akce, na které můžete navštívit přednášky, workshopy, stánky a potkat řadu nadšených chytrých lidí.
articles.title: Galerie z neděle na konferenci LinuxDays 2026

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Vyšla druhá beta verze Plasmy 6.8, GNOME vylepšuje Kalendář, grafiky Battlemage poběží s jádrem Linux 7.4 efektivněji, vyšla vývojová verze Wine 11.19, Coreboot 26.09 přidává podporo Framework Laptop 12 a vlastní AI politiku.
articles.title: KDE Plasma 6.8 za 11 dní, efektivněji běžící Intel Arc Battlemage

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: V sobotu 4. října probíhá v Praze první den letošní konference LinuxDays. Podívejte se, jak vypadá akce, na které můžete navštívit přednášky, workshopy, stánky a potkat řadu nadšených chytrých lidí.
articles.title: Galerie ze soboty na konferenci LinuxDays 2026

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Vyšlo OpenSSH 10.6, které přináší několik změn zaměřených na bezpečnost i praktičtější práci s nástroji kolem SSH. Vývojáři zároveň upozorňují, že v poslední době dostávají velké množství bezpečnostních hlášení vytvořených s pomocí umělé inteligence. Vítají je zejména tehdy, když jsou doplněna lidskou analýzou, testovacím případem nebo přímo návrhem opravy. Do budoucna proto chtějí vydávat opravy častěji a nesoustřeďovat je až do dalšího plánovaného vydání.
articles.title: OpenSSH 10.6 zapíná hybridní postkvantové podpisy

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Blender řady 5 má oficiální podporu API Vulkan a tato podpora uzrála do krásy. A tak vývojáři začínají zvažovat, zdali pro šestkovou řadu již nevyřadit podporu OpenGL, což by jim zjednodušilo údržbu projektu.
articles.title: Blender 6.0 už bez OpenGL, zvažují vývojáři

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Nový X11 server vznikající vibe codingem v Rustu přichází v další nové verzi 1.7. Ta se vyznačuje zejména zlepšeními paměťové náročnosti při běhu.
articles.title: YSERVER 1.7 zlepšuje paměťovou efektivitu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: IFPI, neboli Mezinárodní federace hudebního průmyslu, žádá Evropskou komisi o rozšíření seznamu známého jako Counterfeit and Piracy Watch List. Mezi jinými subjekty by na něj ráda dostala i velmi populární nástroj yt-dlp, sloužící ke stahování streamů nejen z YouTube.
articles.title: IFPI chce dostat yt-dlp na evropský pirátský seznam

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Vilém Sládek)
articles.description: Pořadatelé devátého ročníku komunitního setkání správců nejen českých a slovenských sítí – CSNOG 2027, které se uskuteční 20. a 21. ledna, vyhlásili Call for Abstracts.
articles.title: Organizátoři síťařského setkání CSNOG 2027 vyhlásili Call for Abstracts

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Doom už byl portován na mnoho zvláštních platforem: video adaptér pro HDMI, dokument v PDF nebo přímo na čip grafické karty. Nejnovějším počinem v této oblasti je přenesení původního Doomu do SQL databáze.
articles.title: SQLDoom: hra Doom běžící v SQL databázi

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Útočníkům se podařilo získat přístup k databázi, která obsahuje prakticky všechny identifikační údaje o každé osobě spojené s Dánskem – ať už živé, zemřelé, nebo již dávno odstěhované. Oznámila to dánská ministryně pro digitální záležitosti Christina Egelundová a situaci označila jako „velmi závažný incident“.
articles.title: Únik dat z dánského registru obyvatel se týká 8,8 milionu lidí

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: SmEjDiL)
articles.description: Vývojáři monitorovacího systému Zabbix vydali verzi 8.0.0 RC1, prvního kandidáta připravované verze Zabbix 8.0 LTS. Finální vydání nové LTS řady je plánováno na říjen.
articles.title: Zabbix 8.0.0 RC1 přináší OpenTelemetry a nové APM

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Před nedávnem jsme tu psali, že autor rychlého linkeru Mold Rui Ueyama jej přepisuje z C++ do Rustu. Dnes již vyšel Mold 3.0 v Rustu. Mold 3.0 je přímou náhradou posledního Mold v C++ 2.42.1. Má stejné parametry příkazové řádky, podporuje stejné architektury a produkuje stejný výstup, tedy až na opravené chyby.
articles.title: Rychlý linker Mold 3.0 už je v Rustu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: V červenci se v Krakově konal Python Language Summit 2026, na kterém se hovořilo také o začlenění Rustu do CPythonu. Bylo rozhodnuto, že se začne s modulem zlib, který bude nahrazen zlib-rs v Rustu. Ten je také rychlejší než klasický zlib a často také rychlejší než optimalizovaný zlib-ng.
articles.title: Python se připravuje na Rust v CPythonu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: peci1)
articles.description: Společnost Sylabs oznámila ukončení podpory a vývoje svých kontejnerových backendů Singularity CE a Singularity Pro k datu 25. října 2026. Další detaily firma neuvedla.
articles.title: Společnost Sylabs ukončila vývoj kontejnerového backendu Singularity

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Radioss je software pro výpočet metodou konečných prvků (anglicky FEM finite element method) vyvíjený Altair Engineering. Ten v roce 2022 zveřejnil OpenRadioss jako open source pod licencí GNU AGPLv3. Loni však Siemens koupil Altair a nyní to vypadá, že začlení Radioss do svého software Simcenter.
articles.title: Siemens zrušil OpenRadioss, ale je tu OpenCourant

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Sdružení CESNET spustilo novou službu CESTime, která distribuuje vysoce přesný čas prostřednictvím optických sítí. V CERNu vyvinutá technologie White Rabbit zajišťuje přenos časového signálu a synchronizaci připojených zařízení s přesností na jednotky nanosekund. Oproti běžnému získávání přesného času z družicových navigačních systémů (GNSS), jako jsou GPS nebo Galileo, putuje časový signál z atomových hodin přímo optickou infrastrukturou, oznamuje organizace. CESTime tak nabízí pozemní a na družicovém signálu nezávislý způsob přesné časové synchronizace, což s sebou přináší důležitý prvek bezpečnosti.
articles.title: CESNET zpřístupnil ve své síti superpřesný čas pomocí protokolu White Rabbit

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Radoslav Bodó)
articles.description: Nenechte si ujít oblíbenou podzimní soutěž v kybernetické bezpečnosti The Catch, která odstartuje 5. října 2026 ve 12:00. U jedenáctého ročníku tradiční capture-the-flag soutěže prověříte své znalosti na řadě praktických scénářů z oblasti kybernetické bezpečnosti.
articles.title: The Catch 2026: další ročník soutěže startuje dnes ve dvě hodiny

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Na serveru GOG.com je možné zdarma získat hru Bounty Train od Daedalic Entertainment. Jde o strategickou simulaci parních vlaků na divokém západě.
articles.title: Hra zdarma na GOG.com: Bounty Train

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Byly zveřejněny videozáznamy přednášek z konference LinuxDays 2026, která proběhla 3. a 4. října v Praze. Odkazy na videa společně s prezentacemi naleznete v programu, případně můžete jít rovnou na stránku s videem.
articles.title: Všechna videa z přednášek na LinuxDays 2026 jsou venku

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: O víkendu 3. a 4. října probíhá tradiční podzimní konference LinuxDays. Těšit se můžete na přednášky, workshopy, stánky a spoustu doprovodného programu. Vstup je jako obvykle zdarma, ale pokud se nemůžete zúčastnit osobně, můžete sledovat streamy z přednáškových sálů a během dne se na Root.cz objeví také podrobné fotoreportáže.
articles.title: Začala konference LinuxDays 2026, sledujte živé přenosy

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Ubuntu pokračuje v nahrazování jednotlivých komponent novými, přepsanými v Rustu. Další na řadě pro Ubuntu 26.10 Stonking Stingray je OpenPGP. To bude nahrazeno Sequoia PGP v Rustu. Místo příkazů gpg a gpgv je možné použít nové sq a  sqv.
articles.title: Rustovatění Ubuntu pokračuje, další na řadě je PGP

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Generální ředitel Micronu Sanjay Mehrotra se při příležitosti oznámení tržních výsledků vyjádřil o dostupnosti a ceně pamětí v příštích dvou letech. Většina produkce příštího roku je již prodaná a to za ceny vyšší než v letošním roce. Navíc se bude vyrábět více drahé HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) pro použití v AI. Letos bylo vyráběno asi 20 % HBM, v příštím roce jejich zastoupení vzroste na 30 %. To ještě sníží dostupnost DRAM pro spotřebitelský segment.
articles.title: Generální ředitel Micronu: nedostatek pamětí bude i v roce 2028

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Umělá inteligence poráží nejlepší hráče šachu, go i pokeru. Ale jedna hra doposud odolávala. Jde o stratego, u nás známé spíše jako maršál a špión. Jde o hru podobnou šachu, ale hodnota (síla) figur zůstává skryta až do střetu. Jde tedy o hru s neúplnou informací jako například poker, ale s daleko větším počtem možných kombinací. Typická partie šachu má kolem 40 tahů, jedna partie stratega může často mít i 2 tisíce tahů. Navíc je možné blafovat jako v pokeru.
articles.title: AI poráží nejlepšího hráče hry stratego

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Už tento víkend, 3. a 4. října, proběhne v areálu ČVUT v pražských Dejvicích konference LinuxDays. Návštěvníky čeká více než sedmdesát přednášek, praktické workshopy, stánky open-source komunit a ukázky otevřeného hardwaru. Program se bude odehrávat v několika sálech současně a nabídne témata od vývoje linuxového jádra přes umělou inteligenci až po provoz vlastních služeb. Účast je zdarma, je však potřeba se předem zaregistrovat.
articles.title: Konference LinuxDays 2026 proběhne už tento víkend

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Cloudflare v úterý uvedl, že v budoucnu bude vydávat i postkvantové TLS certifikáty. Ty jsou známé jako  Merkle Tree Certificates (MTC). Vydávat budou hybridní certifikát, který bude obsahovat jak klasický, tak MTC. Služba bude zdarma jak pro platící, tak pro neplatící zákazníky.
articles.title: Cloudflare bude vydávat postkvantové TLS certifikáty

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Bezpečnostní výzkumníci popsali sofistikovaný backdoor pro WordPress, který dokáže přežít i částečné vyčištění napadeného webu. Malware označovaný jako SC je uložen na několika místech současně a jednotlivé kopie se navzájem obnovují. Pouhé smazání podezřelého souboru nebo pluginu proto k odstranění infekce nestačí.
articles.title: Malware pro WordPress se sám léčí a přežije smazání nakažených souborů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Linuxových systémů přibývá, každý den se spouštějí nové servery a někdo se o ně musí starat. To znamená spoustu různých dovedností specifických právě pro linuxové prostředí. Jak to zprovoznit, kudy bezpečně dovnitř, co tam najdeme, jak se o to postaráme a jak to nastavíme nebo rozšíříme.
articles.title: Naučte se používat Linux správně a bezpečně (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Ceny paměťových modulů v posledních dvou letech setrvale narůstají a musejí se tomu přizpůsobovat i výrobci různých zařízení. Několikrát už kvůli tomu vzrostla cena Raspberry Pi, naposledy letos v dubnu, kdy byla zároveň představena 3GB verze.
articles.title: Zvyšují se ceny 2GB variant Raspberry Pi 4 a 5

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: IBM představila vývojářského AI agenta jménem Bob. MapMyDeal propojí nabídky podniků se zákazníky v okolí. Incident OpenAI a Hugging Face ukázal limity softwarové ochrany. Ransomware může zastavit výrobu i bez napadení PLC systémů. Panasonic Toughbook 34 a G3: Odolné tablety s AI a výdrží pro celý den. Panasonic Toughbook slaví 30 let: Počítač, který běžel dál i v hořícím policejním voze. AWS je prvním poskytovatelem cloudových služeb s akreditací NATO RESTRICTED. Miniaturní pracovní stanice pro 4 monitory i AI úlohy. Budoucnost tiskáren: Vstupní brána k AI, ale i bezpečnostní riziko.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Incident OpenAI a Hugging Face ukázal limity softwarové ochrany

articles.description: Gravitace za kolaps vlnové funkce nejspíš nemůže. Život mezi fyzikálními konstantami. Výtrysky černých děr sahají daleko za viditelné okraje galaxií.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Co zabíjí Schrödingerovu kočku?

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Huawei Connect 2026: nová infrastruktura pro AI. Propojí až milion specializovaných procesorů. AI už využívá více než polovina českých velkých podniků. První český fond na transfer technologií AI – do komercionalizace půjde 1,2 mld Kč. Novým cílem útoků je výpočetní výkon umělé inteligence. Tržby z podnikových úložných systémů se meziročně zvýšily o 33,6 %. Útočníci využívají rostoucího zájmu o agentní AI. XPG Mars 980 Blade: PCIe 5.0 disk bez objemného chladiče.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Tržby z podnikových úložných systémů se meziročně zvýšily o 33,6 %

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Život na Marsu by se mohl vyhřívat v dutinách v soli. Helium po velkém třesku: S rekordní přesností určili klíčovou veličinu raného vesmíru. Vytvořili nový porézní diamant, jak ho česky nazvat?
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Hallův jev funguje nejenom kolmo

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: SAP NOW AI Tour Ostrava: Na cestě k autonomnímu podniku. ZEBRA SYSTEMS se mění na ZEBR.AI. Mzdy v IT zpomalily růst, otevřených pozic je méně. SAP NOW 2026: AI má největší potenciál ve výrobě a logistice. Výdaje na zabezpečení AI dosáhnou v roce 2027 výše 4,8 miliardy dolarů. Ransomware udeřil na zdravotnictví, výrobu i IT služby. Unikla citlivá data pacientů. Kód generovaný LLM je stále plný bezpečnostních chyb.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Kód generovaný LLM je stále plný bezpečnostních chyb
