articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Obrovský soubor dat o supernovách zpochybňuje konstantnost temné energie. Mléčná dráha by mohla mít víc satelitních galaxií. Fyzici z FZU sestavili nejmenší QR kód na světě.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Vysvětlili fyziku třepotavého letu motýlů

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: SanDisk Extreme Portable SSD: Rychlé externí NVMe do deště i prachu. HP představuje nové počítače OmniBook pro příští generaci práce s AI. Fortinet varuje před dopady kvantových útoků na podniky. Acer Vero 16 – notebook navržený s důrazem na opravitelnost a výkon s podporou AI. HPE a Oracle rozšiřují spolupráci v oblasti infrastruktury AI. Bez lidí zůstane polovodičová strategie na papíře.
articles.title: Týden na ITBiz: Bez lidí zůstane polovodičová strategie na papíře

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Ucelený přehled článků, zpráviček a diskusí za minulých 7 dní.
articles.title: Událo se v týdnu 37/2026

articles.author: AfD 💙
articles.description: Strata je open-source inferenční engine, který umožňuje lokálně provozovat rozsáhlý čínský model Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, který by jinak nejspíše vyžadoval serverovou infrastrukturu, na běžném herním počítači s alespoň 12 GB VRAM, 32 GB RAM a dostatkem místa na SSD. Nároky na paměť a rychlost generování se liší s použitou variantou modelu Qwen. Zdrojový kód je dostupný na GitHubu, pod licencí MIT.
articles.title: Strata, obří AI v herním PC

articles.author: AfD 💙
articles.description: Americký prezident Donald Trump oznámil vznik federální Jednotky pro superinteligenci (Super Intelligence Force), která má koordinovat postup vlády, technologických firem, náboženských organizací a dalších institucí v oblasti rychle se rozvíjející umělé inteligence (Trumpem oficiálně nazývanou superinteligencí). SIF, podřízená přímo Trumpovi, má pomoci Spojeným státům udržet v oblasti SI technologický náskok nad světem a analyzovat rizika a příležitosti této technologie. V čele jednotky stojí ředitel národních zpravodajských služeb Jay Clayton, dalšími členy jsou šéf Federální obchodní komise Andrew Ferguson, náměstek ministra obrany Emil Michael a ředitel Úřadu pro personální řízení Scott Kupor.
articles.title: Trump tasí superzbraň, federální jednotku pro superinteligenci

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Klient je e-mailový klient pro GNOME s nativní podporou Proton Mailu, PGP a spamfiltrem řízeným AI. Napsaný je v Go s GTK4 a libadwaita. Připojuje se přímo k Proton Mailu (bez Proton Bridge), ke Gmailu, k Seznam.cz a k libovolné schránce IMAP/SMTP. Každou novou zprávu nejdřív posoudí spamfiltr a teprve potom ji ukáže a ohlásí. Rozhraní je česky a anglicky.
articles.title: Klient, e-mailový klient pro GNOME s nativní podporou Proton Mailu, PGP a spamfiltrem řízeným AI

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Hra Doom nově běží také v SQL databázi CedarDB. Představen byl SQLDoom. Vyzkoušet lze online demo. Zdrojové kódy jsou k dispozici na GitHubu.
articles.title: SQLDoom, hra Doom v SQL databázi CedarDB

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Multiplatformní open source aplikace scrcpy (Wikipedie) pro zrcadlení připojeného zařízení se systémem Android na desktopu a umožňující ovládání tohoto zařízení z desktopu, byla vydána v nové verzi 5.0. S podporou hardwarového dekódování videa na desktopu.
articles.title: scrcpy 5.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Moderní linker mold, rychlejší alternativa k LLVM lld nebo wild, byl vydán v nové major verzi 3.0.0. Přepsán byl z C++ do Rustu.
articles.title: mold 3.0.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Po osmi letech od vydání verze 2.0 byla vydána nová major verze 3.0 multiplatformního editoru tagů MusicBrainz Picard (Wikipedie). Přehled novinek, vylepšení a oprav v changelogu.
articles.title: MusicBrainz Picard 3.0

articles.author: AfD 💙
articles.description: Mezinárodní federace hudebního průmyslu (International Federation of the Phonographic Industry) navrhla Evropské komisi zařazení populárního open-source nástroje yt-dlp na evropský seznam 'padělků a pirátství' (EU Counterfeit and Piracy Watch List) pro rok 2027 (plné znění žádosti IFPI). IFPI ve svém podání označuje tento aktivně vyvíjený a o rozličné funkce bohatší fork youtube-dl za 'závažný problém' pro hudební průmysl, v návrhu dokonce explicitně jmenuje čtyři hlavní vývojáře projektu. Dokument neobsahuje přímý požadavek na odstranění repozitáře, yt-dlp je navíc hostován na serverech GitHubu, společnosti sídlící na území USA, mimo pravomoc EU.
articles.title: IFPI žene yt-dlp před Brusel

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána nová verze 7.4 linuxové distribuce Parrot OS (Wikipedie). Jedná se o linuxovou distribuci založenou na Debianu a zaměřenou na penetrační testování, digitální forenzní analýzu, reverzní inženýrství, hacking, anonymitu nebo kryptografii. Přehled novinek v příspěvku na blogu.
articles.title: Parrot OS 7.4

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Dnes startuje desátý ročník oblíbené kyberbezpečnostní soutěže The Catch organizované Forenzní laboratoří CESNETu. Letos zavede soutěžící do světa národních výzkumných a vzdělávacích sítí (NREN). Čekají na vás tematické úlohy založené na principu Capture the Flag (CTF), hledání ukrytých flagů i zajímavé ceny. Otestujte své schopnosti a vyrazte na lov flagů.
articles.title: The Catch 2026

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Back in March Canonical announced switching to ntpd-rs was its next target as part of transitioning more Ubuntu Linux system components to Rust-based implementations. This time synchronization package is available for testing in the upcoming Ubuntu 26.10 release while it aims to be the default for Ubuntu 27.04...
articles.title: Canonical Reaffirms Plans For Ubuntu 27.04 To Use ntpd-rs By Default

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Back in July I wrote about AMD P-State driver patches boosting 1%-low frame rates for gaming by as much as 31%. That work was done by David Vernet who is a Linux kernel engineer/hacker at Meta. This week Vernet presented on the topic at the Linux Plumbers Conference happening in Prague...
articles.title: Meta Engineer's Linux Patches For Boosting AMD P-State / Steam Deck Gaming Performance

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: While most everyone understandably likes to talk about AI these days, one of the areas of NVIDIA's Vera CPU I have been most eager to test has been for conventional high performance computing (HPC) workloads. HPC was talked up as one of Vera's strengths thanks to its 1.2TB/s LPDDR5x memory bandwidth and custom Olympus cores. Vera is seeing deployments at HPC labs like Los Alamos. With recently having unfettered remote access to a dual NVIDIA Vera server, I ran through a variety of HPC workloads and similar performance benchmarks. Here is a look at how NVIDIA Vera performs against AMD EPYC and Intel Xeon, including with CPU power and frequency metrics.
articles.title: NVIDIA Vera HPC Performance Benchmarks Take On AMD EPYC, Intel Xeon

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Timur Kristóf of Valve's Linux graphics team has done an incredible job improving older AMD GPU support under Linux with migrating GCN 1.0/1.1 era hardware to the modern AMDGPU kernel driver and an assortment of other improvements for various older Radeon GPUs. The newest work is on enhancing the RADV Vulkan driver support for old Radeon RX 400/500 "Polaris" graphics cards...
articles.title: Vulkan API Improvements Coming For The AMD Polaris GPUs With Mesa RADV

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: IBM and Red Hat announced today they have identified and remediated more than 400 previously unknown vulnerabilities across popular Java libraries...
articles.title: IBM & Red Hat Find More Than 400 New Vulnerabilities In Popular Java Code

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Intel's LPMD project as the Low Power Mode Daemon for modern Intel Core Ultra desktops and laptops is quite important for achieving peak performance and optimal power efficiency. Here are some of Intel's own findings on the importance of LPMD for Linux gaming..
articles.title: The Importance Of Intel's LPMD For Linux Gaming Performance & Power Efficiency

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: With Blender 5.0 having nice Vulkan API support that's now grown mature, Blender developers are contemplating on potentially removing OpenGL support in Blender 6.0...
articles.title: Blender 6.0 May End Up Removing OpenGL Support

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: With today's memory shortages, high prices, and ever increasing memory capacity needs, Meta engineers have been working on Compressed RAM "CRAM" for Linux. This hardware-offloaded compression still allows cacheline/byte access to compressed memory and in turn a better implementation than the likes of ZRAM and Zswap. Very promising is that there is near-native performance to raw DRAM speeds with CRAM...
articles.title: Meta Developing Compressed RAM "CRAM" For Linux: Better Than ZRAM & Zswap

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Microsoft yesterday released WSL 3.0.2 as their latest WSL update since last week's WSL3 release with "WSLC" for promoting Linux containers on Windows to general availability. Some notable changes in WSL 3.0.2 include automatic virtual NUMA support and experimental support for sparse VHD storage...
articles.title: Windows Subsystem For Linux Can Now Run On Very Large Servers, Experimental Sparse VHD

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Last week at the GNU Tools Cauldron 2026 conference in Prague there was an x86 BOF with presentations both by AMD and Intel compiler engineers. There are a few interesting nuggets out of that with both Advanced Performance Extensions (APX) and AI Compute Extensions (ACE) talked about as part of their ongoing enablement in the GCC compiler...
articles.title: Intel Compiler Engineer Shares Latest Project Gains For APX

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: YSERVER continues seeing a lot of activity for this vibe coded X11 server written in the Rust programming language. YSERVER has been seeing many apps and desktops working fine on this creation crafted in large part by Claude Code and continues chipping away at more X11 features. YSERVER 1.7 is out today with the latest fixes and improvements...
articles.title: YSERVER 1.7 Rust X11 Server Narrows Memory Usage Difference With X.Org Server

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: TrueNAS 27 RC.1 released today in working toward the next major release of this Linux-based storage/NAS operating system from iXsystems...
articles.title: TrueNAS 27 RC.1 Released: Linux 6.18 LTS + OpenZFS 2.4

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Following the ROCm 10.0 release from late August, ROCm 10.1 is now available in continuing with the ROCm six week release cycle...
articles.title: AMD ROCm 10.1 Released With Many Improvements

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: The Linux 7.4 kernel is set to introduce support for a new AMD Zen 6 security feature...
articles.title: Linux 7.4 To Land New BTB CTX Isolation Feature Of AMD Zen 6

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: The open-source Auto-CPUFreq tool for active system monitoring and power optimizations is out with a new release for continuing to enhance battery life on Linux laptops...
articles.title: Auto-CPUFreq 3.2 Adds Configurable HWP Dynamic Boost, Platform Profile Reporting

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: A Phoronix Premium reader recently inquired about seeing some new benchmarks of AI performance between Vulkan and AMD ROCm back-ends to see how the situation plays out today. Here are some fresh benchmarks on two separate systems with AMD Radeon graphics and using the Lemonade local AI server while exploring the difference between the ROCm and Vulkan Llama.cpp back-ends.
articles.title: AMD ROCm vs. Vulkan Performance For Lemonade Local AI Server With Llama.cpp

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: The Mesa 3D driver stack has functioned well over the years without a formal governance model and just relying on an informal consensus approach for big changes. But on some occasions this informal handling has been less than ideal so upstream Mesa developers are now looking at establishing a formal governance model...
articles.title: Mesa Developers Looking At A Formal Governance Model

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: With today's very high memory prices, the Linux ZRAM code for compressed block devices in RAM has seen a rework to provide greater memory savings...
articles.title: Linux's ZRAM Reworked For Greater Memory Savings, Better Performance

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Going back to last year have been patches for booting the mainline Linux kernel on Pixel 10 devices while finally those Google Pixel 10 Device Trees and Tensor G5 SoC support is set to be mainlined for Linux 7.4...
articles.title: Linux 7.4 To Mainline Support For The Google Tensor G5, Pixel 10 Devices

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: The Mold high speed linker alternative to the likes of GNU Gold/LD and LLVM LLD recently has been going through a rewrite from C++ to Rust as well as having high ambitions of eventually becoming the default linker on Linux systems. Today marks the release of Mold 3.0 for this Rust-based high performance linker...
articles.title: Mold 3.0 High Speed Linker Released Following Rust Rewrite

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Back in May we spotted a Linux patch adding "Panther Lake R" as a rugged version of Panther Lake intended for "use in harsh environments". Since Linux 7.2 we have seen some bits of Panther Lake R driver support added while for the upcoming Linux 7.4 cycle there is additional enablement happening for this Panther Lake derivative...
articles.title: Linux 7.4 Continues Preparing For Intel's Rugged Panther Lake

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: A new patch series sent out from Qualcomm that aims to help at least the Snapdragon X series laptops is hardware-binned trip point support. Some Qualcomm SoCs are available in different multiple thermal/package bins with different junction temperature limits but otherwise being the same silicon. The new Linux patches are working to properly convey that information around the thermal limits for a given piece of silicon...
articles.title: Qualcomm Patching Linux For Hardware Thermal Binning To Benefit Snapdragon X Laptops

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: With the upcoming Linux 7.4 kernel the necessary changes to the AMD P-State driver are set to land for properly supporting the upcoming AMD Ryzen client processors based on the Zen 6 cores...
articles.title: Linux 7.4 AMD P-State Driver Will Be Ready For Ryzen Zen 6 CPUs

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Linus Torvalds just released Linux 7.3-rc7 as we work toward the stable Linux 7.3 kernel release in two weeks...
articles.title: Linux 7.3-rc6 Released: Normal For The New "AI Normal"

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: This week was the surprising and unfortunate decision of Siemens shutting down the OpenRadioss project as the four year old open-source project started by Altair Engineering with their prominent Radioss finite element solver. Siemens didn't just end the project but they shutdown the GitHub repository that hosted the open-source code and removed other resources that had built around it. Fortunately, there's a new community fork of OpenRadioss as OpenCourant...
articles.title: OpenCourant: Rocky Linux Developers Create Community Fork Of OpenRadioss

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Linux's Multi-Gen LRU "MGLRU" has already achieved nice performance gains for Linux in recent years by optimizing page reclaims and improves performance under memory pressure. The new MGLRU-FG patches aim to take things further...
articles.title: MGLRU-FG Delivering Up To 10~40% Higher Performance For Linux In Some Tests

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: In addition to NVIDIA announcing their Display Config Server project at XDC 2026 in Toronto, at this annual developer's conference they also presented their findings on scientific testing of X.Org vs. Wayland latency...
articles.title: NVIDIA's Results Of Conducting Wayland vs. X.Org Latency Testing

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Last month Fujitsu formally announced their MONAKA CPU as a 144 core Arm-based server processor geared for AI infrastructure. This comes after two years of seeing various Monaka patches to the GCC compiler and other open-source components. Now that MONAKA is announced, we are seeing more patches surface for the Linux kernel with this week seeing several workarounds for MONAKA CPU bugs...
articles.title: Linux Begins Seeing Workarounds For Fujitsu MONAKA CPU Bugs

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: We are nearing the cut-off of new Direct Rendering Manager (DRM) subsystem material for the upcoming Linux 7.4 cycle. AMD this week sent in another feature pull to DRM-Next that is moving over to mostly bug fixing but does contain the enablement of some new GPU intellectual property blocks for upcoming graphics hardware...
articles.title: AMD Sends In More New GPU Hardware Enablement For Linux 7.4, Bug Fixes

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: OpenSUSE developers have announced they are making ZUPT available on their Linux distribution as a solution for providing post-quantum backups. ZUPT combines backup creation, compression, integrity verification, and encryption all via this single open-source utility...
articles.title: openSUSE Turns To ZUPT For Post-Quantum Backups

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Arm sent out an initial set of patches this week working on support in the Linux kernel for TLBI Domains. This "TLBID" feature is an upcoming Arm architecture capability designed to increase performance on high core count systems...
articles.title: Arm Working On "TLBID" For Linux To Increase Performance On High Core Count CPUs

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Over the past year Timur Kristóf of Valve's Linux graphics driver team has made multiple very nice improvements to the AMDGPU kernel driver for enhancing support for old (GCN 1.0/1.1 era from a decade ago) graphics cards so that they can better handle Linux gaming and other tasks. This week in Toronto, Kristóf presented on this AMDGPU work that he initially began as a kernel driver development exercise after initially spending years in user-space focused on the Mesa 3D driver code...
articles.title: The Amazing Work By Valve's Timur Kristóf On Improving Old AMD GPUs On Linux
Spectrum Allocation
Accelerator Energies
Ground Effect
Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Denuvo has asked a California federal court for permission to subpoena Discord, Valve and Reddit, hoping to unmask the anonymous game cracker 'voices38.' The anti-piracy company wants account details, IP addresses and Steam transaction histories tied to a Discord ID, a Reddit account and seven Steam profiles. The filing also reveals that Denuvo uncovered cryptocurrency transactions by the cracker on the exchange FixedFloat.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Denuvo Asks Court to Unmask Game Cracker ‘voices38’, Reveals Crypto Transactions

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
DNS resolver Quad9 is considering pulling out of France after broadcaster beIN Sports asked a Paris court to impose non-compliance penalties that could go up to €580,000 per day. The Swiss non-profit is not blocking the pirate tennis streams covered by a May site-blocking order, arguing that it can't reliably limit the blocks to French users. A decision is expected later this month.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DNS Resolver Quad9 Rejects French Piracy Blocks, Weighs Exit as beIN Seeks Up to €580K a Day

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every week we take a close look at the most pirated movies on torrent sites. What are pirates downloading? 'Coyote vs. Acme' tops the chart, followed by 'The End of Oak Street.' 'Runner' completes the top three.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 10/05/2026

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The two competing pirate site-blocking bills that were introduced in Congress recently take different approached. While Rep. Darrell Issa's ACPA targets VPNs and provides broad liability protections to Internet service providers, the bipartisan and bicameral DEFEND IP Act explicitly excludes VPNs, while covering more smaller ISPs.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Two U.S. Site-Blocking Bills Compete Over VPN Rules and ISP Liability

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
An alleged operator of pirate IPTV services Kemo IPTV and Lemo TV faces criminal prosecution in Dubai, following a complaint from anti-piracy coalition ACE. The case surprisingly surfaced in a Florida federal court, where DISH Network's request for a $28.65 million default judgment against the same defendants was just denied. According to the judge, DISH failed to show that they were properly served.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Alleged Kemo IPTV Operator Faces Criminal Prosecution in Dubai Following ACE Complaint

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Months after a Spanish court refused to fine NordVPN over IP blocking, LaLiga is now raising its concerns with the European Commission. The football league has asked the EU to add four major VPN providers to its Piracy Watch List, arguing that third-party affiliate marketing guides on how to bypass blockades or circumvent geo-blocking restrictions turn the providers into more than "neutral technical intermediaries." 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: LaLiga Wants Major VPNs on EU Piracy Watch List Over Affiliate Marketing

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Music industry group IFPI has asked the European Commission to add the popular open source YouTube download tool yt-dlp to its Counterfeit and Piracy Watch List. The submission names four of the project's developers by their GitHub handles and describes the software as a major problem for the music industry. What IFPI wants done about the software, however, isn't mentioned.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: IFPI Wants Open Source YouTube Downloader yt-dlp on EU Piracy Watch List

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Senator Thom Tillis and Rep. Zoe Lofgren have introduced their joint site blocking bill, the DEFEND IP Act. The proposal comes less than two weeks after Rep. Darrell Issa's competing proposal, and both bills allow rightsholders to obtain court orders requiring ISPs and large DNS resolvers to block foreign pirate sites. A crucial difference is that the unified bill explicitly leaves VPN providers out.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Unified U.S. Site Blocking Bill Targets ISPs and DNS Resolvers But Spares VPNs

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A Washington federal court has ordered former r/SwitchPirates moderator James 'Archbox' Williams to pay Nintendo $4.5 million in damages. The default judgment includes a permanent injunction that prohibits Williams from distributing pirated games and circumvention tools, or encouraging others to use them. Whether Nintendo will be able to recoup the damages is unclear, as Williams never answered the allegations.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Nintendo Wins $4.5 Million Judgment Against r/SwitchPirates Mod ‘Archbox’

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
China's biggest streaming companies are using U.S. courts to take down pirate sites, and a Florida judge just made that path easier. Overruling a magistrate's recommendation, the court ruled that the Chinese-language pirate site Olevod, which is run by a Spanish company, must answer Tencent's lawsuit in Florida. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Site Must Face Chinese Streaming Giant Tencent in U.S. Court, Judge Rules

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
ACE has announced the shutdown of LiveNetTV, a free IPTV app that survived for a decade despite legal pressure from multiple sides. Two Turkey-based operators settled with ACE. They handed over ten domain names and issued a public mea culpa. The app itself had been dead since Istanbul police raided its operators in February.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV App LiveNetTV Shut Down After Turkish Police Raid, Operators Settle With ACE

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
VPN providers with over 100,000 American users could be ordered to block pirate sites under the bill Rep. Darrell Issa introduced last week. The full text shows that VPNs were added after last year's discussion draft, which only mentioned ISPs and DNS resolvers. How a VPN should block access "from the United States" remains an open question, as the technical implementation is not defined.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: U.S. Site Blocking Bill Adds VPNs to the List of Blocking Intermediaries

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
At a global film summit in France, regulators and rightsholders praised site-blocking successes, but they also faced unexpected pushback from one of the panelists. South Africa's culture minister accused the film industry of a double standard on piracy, demanding a partnership of equals rather than external mandates.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: South African Minister Tells Film Summit It Has a Double Standard on Piracy

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Google, Cloudflare, and Cisco lost a key challenge against a Belgian DNS blocking order. The revised injunction, obtained by sports rightsholder DAZN, requires alternative resolvers to block pirate sports streaming domains on match days. Cisco says it will suspend OpenDNS in Belgium rather than comply, and intends to appeal.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Court Upholds Belgian Pirate DNS Blocking Order, OpenDNS Exit Looms

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Anti-piracy outfit Denuvo has filed a DMCA anti-circumvention lawsuit in a U.S. federal court, targeting the anonymous game cracker known as 'voices38.' The defendant stands accused of bypassing Denuvo's digital locks on more than two dozen games, including Hogwarts Legacy and Black Myth: Wukong. As the case moves forward, the company will likely subpoena Reddit, Discord, and Valve for the cracker's identifying information.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Denuvo Sues Game Cracker ‘voices38’ for Bypassing its Anti-Tamper DRM

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
U.S. Representative Darrell Issa has officially introduced a new bill that aims to block foreign pirate sites in the United States. While the final text has yet to be published, an early draft suggests that both ISPs and DNS resolvers will be covered. The bill has already triggered opposition, while there is also internal competition from competing site blocking efforts on the Hill.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Rep. Issa Files Competing U.S. Pirate Site Blocking Bill

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The person who sued PassThePopcorn, BroadcasTheNet, HDBits, and three other private trackers has voluntarily dropped the case, but it's not over yet. Through their attorneys, some of the alleged tracker operators want to uncover the identity of the man who allegedly impersonated a Canadian filmmaker. At a recent hearing, defense counsel offered a theory of motive: a former tracker user who was banned after selling or trading invites.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Accused Impostor in Private Tracker Lawsuit Driven by Revenge, Defense Says

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Meta previously argued that uploading pirated books to other BitTorrent users was an unavoidable side effect of downloading them, and therefore fair use. Rightsholders suing Meta in three related cases tried to dismantle this theory by asking OpenAI and Anthropic to reveal how they torrented shadow library data. A magistrate judge denied the request, but that's not the end of the torrenting dispute. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Rightsholders Can’t Use OpenAI and Anthropic to Dismantle Meta’s Seeding Defense

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Six months after Vietnamese police shut down the country's notorious pirate football streaming network 'Xoi Lac TV', investigators have recommended criminal charges against 74 people. While pirated streams drew millions of people to the sites, the operators face the most severe prison sentences for generating millions of dollars through illegal gambling ads.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (mohit)
articles.description:
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce that Lord Avalot d'Argent, the quirky 1994 comedic adventure by Thorsoft of Letchworth, is ready for public testing!
The year is 1179. When Baron Michel de Lustie is denied the princess's hand in marriage, he kidnaps her for a steep 50-pence ransom. With England’s finest knight conveniently away on vacation, the desperate king turns to you: the reluctant and decidedly less-than-heroic Lord Avalot d'Argent. It is up to you to set off across Britain, solve odd puzzles, outwit strange characters, and somehow bring the princess back.
Inspired by early Sierra classics like King's Quest, the game blends animated graphical exploration with a traditional text parser and convenient mouse menus.
For this testing period, ScummVM supports the original DOS release, powered by the Avalanche engine.
To join the test, grab a recent daily development build, add your game directory to ScummVM, and set out on the quest. Please report any problems you encounter on our issue tracker.
England's champion is on holiday, the princess has been kidnapped, and Avalot has somehow been chosen for the job. Are you ready to put his competence to the test?
>
articles.title: A less-than-heroic Lord

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (alexbevi)
articles.description:
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce that Harvester is ready for public testing!
You wake up in the small Texas farming town of Harvest. Who are you? How did you get here? Why does it seem to be the 1950s? What’s the Order of the Harvest Moon?
Harvester is an adventure/horror game, full of quirky characters, campy FMV cutscenes, B-list acting, real-time combat sequences and all the pixel-hunting goodness the genre is known for. Engage with the citizens of Harvest and uncover the town’s secrets as you attempt to gain access to the Lodge to uncover the truth.
For this testing period, ScummVM supports the English, French and European versions. Once you’ve obtained a supported version, see the wiki for guidance on extracting the necessary data files.
Harvester depicts scenes of graphic violence, sex and gore, and may not be everyone’s cup of tea. If you’re not put off by this and want to help us test the games, start by grabbing a daily build and get playing! Don’t forget to read through our testing guidelines, and please take some screenshots along the way.
>
articles.title: You always were a kidder, Steve

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (moralrecordings)
articles.description:
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce that The Fool's Errand is ready for public testing!
The Fool's Errand is a critically-acclaimed narrative puzzle game based on characters and arcana from the tarot. Help the Fool as he uncovers the lost fourteen treasures of the world, averts all-out war between the four kingdoms, and defies the wrath of the evil High Priestess. Each puzzle solved reveals a new piece of the story, and builds to an overarching metapuzzle that ties all of the threads together.
For this testing period, ScummVM supports the original Macintosh edition of the game - the ports for DOS, Amiga and Atari use a different engine and are not covered by this announcement. All known versions of the Macintosh edition should be supported and completable. But there's an old saying that a reverse engineer who hires themselves as a beta tester has a fool for a client, so don't take our word for it!
Help us test the games by grabbing a daily build. Read through our testing guidelines. And please take some screenshots along the way. The wiki page for the game explains which files are needed and how to extract them.
If you encounter any unexpected treachery, such as game-breaking bugs or a revision of the game which does not open in ScummVM, please report it on our issue tracker following our bug submission guidelines.
>
articles.title: Fool me Once, Shame on You...

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (Scorp)
articles.description:
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce that Amerzone: The Explorer’s Legacy, The Cameron Files: The Secret at Loch Ness, and The Messenger / Louvre: The Final Curse are ready for public testing!
In Amerzone: The Explorer’s Legacy, an old explorer’s final wish sends a young journalist to a hidden land with some precious cargo: the stolen egg of the legendary White Birds. Sail, drive, and puzzle your way through Benoît Sokal’s world of strange wildlife, rusting machinery, and forgotten history.
Loch Ness takes private investigator Alan P. Cameron to the Scottish Highlands, where ghostly apparitions trouble Devil’s Ridge Manor—and his client has vanished. Search for clues, uncover a secret laboratory, and keep an eye on the loch. Some mysteries lurk beneath the surface.
In The Messenger/ Louvre: The Final Curse, agent Morgane Sinclair must recover four dangerous artefacts before the Black Templars can unleash their power. Travel through different eras of the Louvre’s history, mixing modern gadgets with ancient magic. This museum visit comes with considerably more at stake than the admission fee.
All three games run on the PhoenixVR engine, also used by Dracula: Resurrection and Dracula 2: The Last Sanctuary.
Please note that only the Windows versions of these games are supported. The Macintosh and PSX versions use a different engine.
To join the testing, grab a recent daily development build and your original game data files. Report any bugs on our issue tracker, including your ScummVM version, game edition and language, and steps to reproduce the problem.
Mind the egg, watch the water, and try not to end the world. Happy testing!
>
articles.title: White Birds, Dark Waters, and a Curse at the Louvre

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (bluegr)
articles.description:
Grab your magnifying glass and pack your bags, because Nancy is back on the road! We are pleased to announce that ScummVM now supports four more titles from the Nancy Drew adventure game series, taking the famous detective from a charming 1930s country inn all the way to the volcanic slopes of Hawaii.
In Nancy Drew: Secret of the Old Clock, Nancy visits the Lilac Inn, run by 17-year-old Emily Crandall. A kindly neighbor promised Emily his estate, but when he dies, his will leaves everything to someone else! Meanwhile, objects vanish and reappear, and whispers echo through the empty halls of the inn.
In Nancy Drew: Last Train to Blue Moon Canyon, Nancy and the Hardy Boys join socialite Lori Girard on a train trip to solve a century-old mystery: the disappearance of the train's original owner, Jake Hurley, rumored to have found a fabulous gold mine. But as soon as the journey begins, Lori herself vanishes...
In Nancy Drew: Danger by Design, Nancy goes undercover in Paris as an assistant to Minette, a couture fashion designer who has been throwing tantrums, firing her staff, and refusing to be seen without a mask covering her face. What is she hiding?
In Nancy Drew: The Creature of Kapu Cave, Nancy arrives in Hawaii to assist entomologist Dr. Quigley Kim, only to find her camp ravaged and the doctor missing. Locals whisper that a legendary creature has awoken to prowl the island, and it's up to Nancy and the Hardy Boys to team up and crack the case.
As usual, you will need the original game data files to play these games. The games are available for purchase through HeR Interactive's website or Steam. To play them with ScummVM, you will need a daily development build. If you encounter any issues, please submit a bug report to our issue tracker, following our bug submission guidelines.
The case files are open, and the clues are waiting. Happy investigating!
>
articles.title: Four More Cases for Nancy Drew

articles.description: Především: Všechny trailery a jiné propagační materiály zásadním způsobem lžou o tom, co je tenhle film zač (včetně jeho žánru) a jaká je jeho zápletka. Tom Cruise v něm například NEHRAJE miliardáře jménem Digger, John Goodman NEHRAJE prezidenta a v průběhu filmu nezačne žádná environmentální katastrofa. Film je o podobných věcech, ale je o nich jiným, zajímavějším způsobem, než se zdá z jeho propagace. Následkem toho na něj do kina nepůjdou ti diváci, kterým by se mohl líbit, a naopak. Velmi jsem ocenil, že se nějakým bizarním způsobem podařilo natočit takhle okrajový artfilm s tak obrovským rozpočtem, ale film je bohužel příliš dlouhý a ty extrémně originální a zajímavé scény jsou prokládány desítkami minut něčeho, co je velmi předvídatelné. (Ilča 60 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Digger - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Polovinu filmu je docela slušně budováno mysteriózní napětí, ale pak začne čím dál více vycházet najevo debilita scénáře (tedy zřejmě i knižní předlohy). Pokud se zpětně zamyslíte nad tím, proč kdo komplikovaně dělal to, co ve filmu dělal, nedává to žádný smysl. Červená knihovna především pro dámy, velmi podobně vystavěná jako "Pomocnice", ale ještě o něco horší. (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Pravda, nebo lež [Verity] - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Slušný komorní survival s dvěma charismatickými hlavními hrdiny (s celkem šesti nohama). Scénář mohl být zajímavější a úvodní čtvrthodina je víceméně zbytečná. "Mezi vlky" s Liamem Neesonem je velmi podobný a o trochu lepší film. (Ilča 60 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: V srdci divočiny [Heart of the Beast] - 70 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description:
Film má 110 minut. Z toho přibližně třetina jsou dokumentární střípky ze života lidí, kteří jsou psychicky i fyzicky zcela na dně a občas se tomu pokusí vzepřít. To bylo poměrně zajímavé a možná i poučné ("Katka" a "Láska v hrobě" jsou mé oblíbené filmy). Zbylé dvě třetiny filmu nám pak autorka sděluje, jaké náhodné myšlenky se jí právě honí hlavou a jak vzpomíná na své dětství (obojí je záměrně velmi chaotické a "pocitové"), což mě naprosto nezaujalo svým obsahem ani formou. articles.description: Technicky a řemeslně dokonalé (animace, kamera, hudba...). Herecké výkony OK, John Cena vypadá jako animovaná postavička. It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled certain HTTP/2 requests.
A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of
service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.
(CVE-2026-4271)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled certain HTTPS proxy
connections. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain
sensitive information. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu
24.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-5119)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly parsed certain chunked HTTP
requests. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to bypass
security controls. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04
LTS, and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-6324)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled proxy authentication
credentials. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain
sensitive information. (CVE-2026-66339)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled certain HTTP Range
headers. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial
of service. (CVE-2026-77014, CVE-2026-77680)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled certain HTTP/2
connections. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain
sensitive information or execute arbitrary code. This issue only affected
Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-85197)

It was discovered that libsoup incorrectly handled certain HTTP/2
transfers. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a
denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04
LTS, and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-85534)
articles.title: USN-8890-1: libsoup vulnerabilities

Timo Preißl discovered that U-Boot incorrectly handled certain malformed
ZFS file system metadata. An attacker could possibly use this issue to
trigger an integer overflow and out-of-bounds memory access, resulting in
arbitrary code execution or a denial of service. (CVE-2025-70290)

Timo Preißl discovered that U-Boot incorrectly calculated buffer sizes when
processing certain ext4 file systems. An attacker could possibly use this
issue to trigger an integer overflow and out-of-bounds memory access,
resulting in arbitrary code execution or a denial of service. This issue
only affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu
24.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. (CVE-2025-70293)

Mateusz Furdyna discovered that U-Boot incorrectly handled certain
fragmented IP traffic when IP defragmentation was enabled. An attacker
could possibly use this issue to corrupt memory by sending crafted IP
fragments, resulting in arbitrary code execution. (CVE-2026-15390)

Shahriyar Jalayeri and Mehrun P. Hunter discovered that U-Boot incorrectly
handled certain fragmented IP traffic during network boot when IP
defragmentation was enabled. An attacker could possibly use this issue to
trigger an out-of-bounds write, resulting in a denial of service.
(CVE-2026-71971)
articles.title: USN-8884-1: U-Boot vulnerabilities

It was discovered that FluidSynth did not properly validate the channel
argument of the pitch_bend_range command. A remote attacker could
possibly use this issue to cause FluidSynth to crash, resulting in a
denial of service, or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-58264)

It was discovered that FluidSynth incorrectly handled configurations with
more than 16 MIDI channels in its MIDI player, leading to a heap buffer
overflow. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause FluidSynth
to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or execute arbitrary code.
This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and Ubuntu
26.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-61714)

cause Tesseract to crash, resulting in a denial of service.
